name: @stapel/attributes-react
description: React value layer for stapel-attributes' dynamic feature types: a value-editor registry keyed on config.type (explicit registration > skin builtin > loud unsupported notice, with the submit blocked and the reason named), a client-side validation mirror that speaks the engine's own error.400.feature_* keys (pattern as fullmatch, string length in Unicode code points), DTO helpers for the {slug: {type, value}} wire shape, and display formatting. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd editors for all ten builtin types plus <FeatureFields> and <FeatureBadges>.

size-limit.name: index — the registry + mirror + DTO helpers must stay React-only: no antd (8 → 8.5 KB: the eleven picker keys and their English floor ride in the shared bundle; → 8.75 KB: the step-ladder predicates a host asks BEFORE it draws — visible rows, visible blocks, missing required; → 9 KB: the popular-band readers on the vocabulary seam and the two band headings in the English floor) Raised 9 -> 9.25 KB for the AXIS ROLE (stapel-attributes 0.9.2): `src/axis.ts` — `AXIS_ROLES`, `axisRoleOf` and `byAxisRole`, the browser half of `stapel_attributes/axis.py`, including the rule that a role two features claim is DROPPED rather than resolved. Measured with dependencies held constant, this package's src without the module and then with it: 8957 -> 9072 B. The 115 B is a storefront's slug table (`brand` / `make` / `make_ref_select` / `vendor`) deleted and replaced by the catalogue's own answer — it belongs on the headless entry because the consumers are a link builder and an AI descent, neither of which draws anything. Raised 9.25 -> 10 KB for the GENERATED ERROR REGISTRY (stapel-attributes 0.9.4): the library emits docs/errors.json now, so `pnpm gen:errors` produces this pair's bundles and the thirteen en strings that were retyped in i18n/keys.ts are a re-export of the generated en bundle — which is the whole registry, the 13 owned keys plus the 42 cross-cutting stapel_core ones. Measured with dependencies held constant, this package's src before and after: 9.25 KB limit exceeded by 468 B, so 9.72 KB against a 10 KB line. The 468 B buys a floor that CANNOT drift from the library's own registry, in place of thirteen strings a person kept in step by reading. A host that also registers @stapel/core's bundle gets core's 42 twice in source and once on screen; the pair-authored copy it replaces had the same overlap and no gate.

default — the antd value editors must stay out of the main bundle (16 → 17.5 KB: progressive disclosure and the bake write-backs on the fields, the vocabulary-backed int editor with its stepper/suggestion combo, and paging on every picker sheet; → 18.75 KB: the BOUNDED int — keypad, dropdown of the allowed values, steppers and the moved-bound reset — which is the mechanism a year field had prose for; → 19 KB: the ceiling above was set from a measurement taken mid-change and came up 68 B short of the finished one. Re-measured with dependencies held constant, this package's src at the commit before the chip/bounded-int fix and then at it: 18.49 -> 18.82 KB. The 330 B is the bounded int saying WHICH state it is in — at a bound, past a moved bound, off the allowed set — in text a screen reader reads rather than in a disabled stepper, plus the chip that now carries its own label. A control that refuses a value has to say which rule it is refusing under, and that sentence is markup, not prose in a doc) Raised 19 -> 19.25 KB: the vocabulary-backed int refuses a number in the three states where its allowed set is NOT loaded (fetch in flight, parent unanswered, a level this side cannot know), falling back to the catalogue's own min/max, and routes the sentence through SkinNumberField's errorText so aria-describedby binds it to the input instead of leaving it a line addressed by nothing. Measured with dependencies held constant, this package's src at HEAD and then with the change: 18.97 -> 19.05 KB. 19.25 KB HOLDS for the paging-race fix (this wave): measured 19230 B against the 19.25 KB line, 8 B over the 19222 B the same src measures without it. `useTermSearch` keeps its answer in a ref written alongside the state so `more` stops being rebuilt on every landed page — the skin installs its end-of-list listener in an effect keyed on that identity, and the gap between the commit that painted a page and the effect that installed the matching listener was letting a scroll re-ask for the page already on screen. A budget is not raised for a change that fits under the line it already has. Raised 19.25 -> 20.25 KB by the same 0.9.4 change: the antd entry re-exports the main entry's English floor, so the generated registry lands here too. Measured 19.9 KB against the old 19.25 KB line — the same 651 B of generated en text, not new code.
i18n/ru — the Russian bundle is opt-in, not carried by the main entry
i18n/es — the Spanish bundle is opt-in, not carried by the main entry
